== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The [[Inquisitors]] are the spider-like minions of a [[Great Elder]] known as Ach'magut{{!}}Ach’magut, also called the [[Overseer]]. These creatures possess ten legs and numerous eyes situated on flexible stalks. While they are typically known for observing from a distance, they have been observed acting with uncharacteristic boldness, such as abducting the elderly and those with mental infirmities to perform rituals intended to summon the void. They are capable of swarming in large numbers and have been known to react with excitement toward certain objects, such as the [[Awakened nail]]. Historically, these entities only coordinate their actions when acting under the direct command of Ach'magut{{!}}Ach’magut; however, because he was believed to be dead for over two millennia, their recent activities suggest his potential revival and the implementation of a long-standing plan.}}
